title: Shortest Distance to a Character
summary: For a string s and a character c found within s, generate an array answer of the same length as s.
statement: For a string s and a character c found within s, generate an array answer of the same length as s. Each element answer[i] represents the shortest distance from index i to the nearest occurrence of c in s, calculated as the absolute difference between indices.
constraints: c occurs at least once in s.
Return each position’s distance to the nearest occurrence of c.
hints: Nearest distance is the minimum of nearest occurrences to the left and right.
Make one forward and one backward pass.
Store i-last_seen forward; backward replace with min(current,last_seen-i).
Each pass supplies the closest occurrence on its side, and their minimum is globally closest.
editorial: Each pass supplies the closest occurrence on its side, and their minimum is globally closest.

tests.explanation: The nearest e on either side yields [3,2,1,0,1,0,0,1,2,2,1,0].
Distances decrease from three to zero approaching the final b.
